Let's start with contract counsel on the agreement terms, the client liaison on where things stand with the client, legal operations on resourcing, and conflicts counsel on any issues. Please bring me up to speed.

transcript.text:
Thank you all for these critical updates. Let me synthesize where we stand and what needs to happen.

First, Daniel -- thank you for flagging the ICDR forum in New York with a three-arbitrator panel. That fundamentally changes how we structure the demand package. Please circulate the executed schedule to the full team today so everyone is working from the same document.

Second, Thomas -- the $2.4 million direct-damages figure must be incorporated into the demand before I'll approve it. Please coordinate with whoever is drafting the demand to get that number in.

Third, Maya -- the client's non-monetary objectives are noted and clearly urgent given the supplier's threat. We need to structure the demand to seek: (1) an order restoring access to the implementation environment, (2) return or destruction of the client's source code, and (3) confidentiality protections for that material. Please get the intake form updated today.

Fourth, Iris -- I hear you clearly that the conflicts issue is a gating item. I will not approve the demand without your clearance memo. That said, the timeline pressure is real. Please make confirming the scope of the prior representation your top priority. If we can't get the clearance memo issued quickly, we need to know that now so we can assess whether we need to staff this matter differently to meet the month-end deadline.

Here's what I need from everyone before our next check-in: Daniel, circulate the schedule and confirm the forum structure in writing. Thomas, confirm the damages figure is in the draft. Maya, update the intake form and coordinate with the client on the urgency of the non-monetary relief. Iris, give me your best estimate on when the scope confirmation will be complete and whether we should consider alternative staffing as a contingency. Let's reconvene as soon as Iris has an update on the conflicts timeline.
